summary: Implemented parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError in rdflib/extras/shacl.py, with tests in test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass (43 passed) under the shared venv Python. Nothing is committed. mypy, black, and isort are not installed in the shared venv, so type checking and formatting were verified by reading only. One deliberate deviation: a runtime guard rejects non-Node inputs (None, strings) with SHACLPathError, because graph.value(None, ...) would otherwise act as a wildcard.
